input.camera_model: fixed pinhole, f=180 px, distance=130 mm
input.camera_bundle: per-case cameras.npz, world_to_camera, known millimetre scale

pipeline.hypothesis_selection: GT-blind observation gates, then grammar fit plus operation-count penalty; all three cases select extrude and reject revolve on radial symmetry
pipeline.profile_evidence: filtered observations estimate orientation and score surfaces; the outer sketch uses raw 3D occupancy optionally intersected with multi-view silhouette consensus
pipeline.orientation: PCA plus accepted reflection symmetry; near-coincident PCA axes are snapped to the measured symmetry normal
pipeline.aperture_evidence: repeated RGB-mask voids gate topology; matching enclosed raw 3D-profile void measures center and radius

cases.scale_evidence: known camera bundle, 1 world unit = 1 mm
cases.outer_profile: 4 lines from raw 3D intersected with five-of-eight silhouette consensus

cases.ground_truth: outer diameter 44 mm x 8 mm, through-hole diameter 12 mm
cases.scale_evidence: known camera bundle, 1 world unit = 1 mm
cases.apertures: one circle: topology supported by views 4, 5, 6, 7; radius measured from matching enclosed raw 3D-profile void

cases.ground_truth: 50 x 32 x 28 mm L-bracket with 6 mm walls
cases.scale_evidence: known camera bundle, 1 world unit = 1 mm
cases.outer_profile: 20-line concave polyline from raw 3D intersected with seven-of-eight silhouette consensus
cases.topology: concave L-like profile recovered without a part class; no template or reference CAD is used

claim_boundary: Three deterministic calibrated integration cases, not category-level accuracy. Valid STEP does not imply correct CAD topology or dimensions.
